articles.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
articles.essence: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. articles.title: PC shipments dropped over 20 percent in Q3 due to RAM price hikes
articles.essence: Demand for new PCs took a hit after months of price hikes, with Counterpoint Research reporting global PC shipments fell 21 percent year-over-year in Q3 2026. That's in line with earlier reports from IDC and Omdia.

articles.title: Fall 2026 earnings watch
articles.essence: Every company is suddenly an AI company. Compute is an asset.
articles.full_body: Every company is suddenly an AI company. Compute is an asset. We’ve been promised robots — again. It’s time again to dig through earnings reports, listen to investor calls, and call out the latest wins and losses from around the tech sector and what it means for where the companies go next.
